argument: ψ = [ε(h) ∉ span ε(G)] is a surjective homomorphism H -> F2 with G ⊆ ker ψ. Schreier generators of ker ψ for the transversal {1, a} are t·s·rep(t·s)^-1. Each is certified in G by a word of existing atoms replayed through the engine to the exact solved state. All certified => G = ker ψ => [H:G] = 2.
wordConvention: Words are applied left to right to the solved state; `+<key>` is an additional atom, `<id>@<angle>` an existing one.
